data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior-year reserve release in 2014 of $33.9m (2013: $49.7m), driven by favourable claims development across divisions. The gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year (1 January 2014) was $741.5m and fell to $705.7m at year end (exchange adjustments also impacted the movement). Releases were distributed across Marine, Political risks & contingency, Property, Reinsurance and Specialty lines, and the level of 2014 releases is described as in line with the five-year average.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2014 = 741.5). Prior year reserve movement taken from Managing Agent narrative and divisional table stating releases of $33.9m - these division figures sum to 33.9 and are presented as 'releases' (treated here as gross releases). The report's amounts are denominated in USD; field names contain 'gbp_m' by schema convention but numbers are native currency (USD millions). Confidence reduced for prior_year_development because the narrative figure is explicit but the technical notes do not present a single labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column separate from total movement; if gross/net ambiguity discovered, the figure may represent net of reinsurance though the divisional table appears to be gross.
